correctness.rationale: The spanning-tree classification is complete: with spine edge uv, independently choose exactly one of two incident leaf edges for each leaf (2^n trees); without spine, exactly one leaf bridges both hubs and all remaining leaves choose one (n 2^{n-1} trees). Every signed coefficient is therefore c∏(a_i+b_i)+∑_j a_jb_j ∏_{i≠j}(a_i+b_i). Inspect number d of discordant sign pairs: d≥2 zero, d=1 gives -2^{n-1} product of other matching a_i, d=0 gives 2^{n-1}∏a_i(2c+∑a_i). Disjoint classes show exact all-n transform; even n has 2*C(n,n/2-1) extra equal-pair zeros, yielding rank formula and sharp nonzero gap 2^{n-1}, upper bound (n+2)2^{n-1}. The Fourier projector onto tree incidence *frequencies* has convolution kernel W/2^{2n+1}; its L1 absolute sum is n/2 + (1/2) E max(|S_n|,2). Exact binomial telescoping gives claimed formula, and removing the spine yields K2n prior norm, hence the central binomial increment 2^{-n}C(n,floor n/2). Independent enumeration of all trees and complete Walsh transforms for n=1..6 reproduced every coefficient, rank, extremes and norm. The symbolic tree classification and binomial identities, not finite trials, prove all n.
